mapper.insert: INSERT INTO patients (name, region_id, shard_key, email, phone, date_of_birth, address, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{regionId}, #{shardKey}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{dateOfBirth}, #{address}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE patients SET name = #{name}, region_id = #{regionId}, shard_key = #{shardKey}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, date_of_birth = #{dateOfBirth}, address = #{address}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE patient_id = #{patientId}
